description: Root extension point, inherited by every stack. Universal, low-footprint plugins: active security review (Security Guidance).

plugins.description: Security Guidance (Anthropic, official) - ACTIVE runtime hooks, not prose: PostToolUse regex warnings on every Edit/Write (~25 dangerous patterns), a Stop-hook LLM diff review, and an agentic cross-file review on git commit (injection/XSS/SSRF/IDOR/auth-bypass/unsafe-deserialization/secrets). Fully local (uses your Claude session, no external calls). COMPLEMENTARY to rules/security.md (that guidance shapes what gets written BEFORE; this catches unsafe code AFTER + at commit). NOTE: the Stop-hook review is an extra LLM call per turn (cost/latency); its commit review overlaps in place - not in purpose - with this config's secrets-gate.mjs.
